description: Land Title Settlement Department - Rawathawatta, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520201
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the determination of land titles for various parcels in Rawatawatta under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed information about land parcels, their owners, extents, and legal status, which falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
